$comment: CI seconds per test file (fork start, import, collection and tests, as FileDurationsReporter records them) that durationShards in @al-ft/midgard-test-support packs --shard by, and withDurationTier in @al-ft/midgard-test-support/vitest splits into the fast tier and the slow tier (files at or over SLOW_TIER_FILE_SECONDS). Each file is the median of Node CI runs 44252349699, 44209831618 and 43921606823 (commits 5a6e58e36, a6fc14a5f and 5b012594a); one run's records carry its runners' speeds. forksPerShard is the CI fork cap (MIDGARD_FAULT_PROOF_FORKS). reservedSeconds is the traced-refusal step that only shard 1 runs after its tests: 2,038/1,602/2,236 s in those runs, median 2,038. The five script-decode-walk-gate.nested-lists-* files, split from two files after those runs, carry their old file's seconds shared out by their rows' seconds in one local run; the two transition-trace-final-maximum-lifecycle files, split from one, carry half of its seconds each. Refresh with demo/midgard-test-support/scripts/ci-file-durations.mjs --run <id> --run <id> ..., or take the ci-file-durations artifact of any Node CI run. A stale or missing entry only costs shard balance, or leaves a newly slow file in the fast tier until the next refresh, never coverage.
